notes: Four-lane parallel sweep (ai / bigtech+hardware+mobile / devtools+cloud / security) via background subagents, ~130 queries total. No genuine new same-day (Oct 26/27) announcement surfaced in any lane. Every lane's forward-looking candidates were cross-checked by hand against the full data/events corpus (not just the recent-months skim) before filing: the large majority (OpenAI fine-tuning/Realtime retirements, Azure gpt-5 retirement, Amazon Bedrock Opus 4.1 EOL, Azure East US 3/Atlanta region, AWS Chile region, AKS 1.35 EOL, NeurIPS Sydney dates, RSA/Black Hat/DEF CON 2027, Let's Encrypt 64-day certs, Microsoft Patch Tuesday Jan 2027) turned out to already be on file, several in already-flagged near-duplicate clusters, and were deliberately not re-filed. What's filed below is the residue that is genuinely new or a real improvement.
concerns: The security lane found a CA/Browser Forum ballot (SC098v2, CAA/RFC 8657 parameter processing) with an effective date of 2027-03-15 — the exact same date as the already-quadruplicated 'CA/Browser Forum cuts max public TLS certificate validity to 100 days' cluster in data/events/2027-03.json. It is a substantively different requirement, but given the known sameTitle/sameOrg dedupe bug in src/lib/id.ts (flagged in run logs since 2026-10-23) that has already let four near-identical rows accumulate on that exact date/org, filing a fifth same-date/same-org row risked silently corrupting one of the existing four rather than adding a clean new one. Left unfiled rather than risk it; worth a maintainer check against cabforum.org's own ballot page and a manual add once the dedupe fix lands.

Google Play's Contacts & Location permission policy has three different effective dates floating around across lanes and the existing corpus: a pre-review-checks date already on file at 2026-10-27, a 'policy takes effect' date already on file at 2027-01-27, and this run's bigtech lane turned up a third claim (Contact Picker mandatory from 2026-10-28, sourced to Google's own April 2026 developer newsletter). Rather than add a third/conflicting row to an area that already looks like a phased-rollout mess, left it unfiled — worth a maintainer pass to confirm from Google's Play Console policy page which dates are real phases of the same rollout (pre-review warnings vs. enforcement) and consolidate the wording.

AMD's MI400-series/Helios rack-scale mass-production date is contested: data/events/2027-01.json already carries 'AMD Instinct MI430X targeted for early-2027 shipments', while this run's bigtech lane found separate, lower-confidence reporting that mass production/first production units have slipped to Q2 2027 (undisclosed thermal issue, not mentioned in AMD's own results). Left unfiled since it would directly contradict an existing confirmed-ish entry without a strong enough source to override it — worth a direct check against AMD's own newsroom once reachable.

The Chrome Root Program's planned removal of the client-auth EKU from public certs still has no primary Google source reachable in this sandbox and secondary sources still disagree on the exact day (Feb 1 vs Mar 1 vs Mar 15, 2027) — same gap flagged in the 2026-10-26 run log, still unresolved.
